title: Ancillary Account Tier Assignment and Account Closing (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
The tier of an Ancillary and Optional Services Billing account follows the payer source of the resident's stay on the date of service: a Part A episode places the account in the consolidated billing tier, a Medicaid eligible case in the Medical Assistance tier, a hospice election in the hospice tier, a Medicare Advantage stay in that tier, and a private-pay or Medicaid-pending stay in the Part B tier when the resident has Part B and otherwise the private pay tier. An account is closed only when its balance is zero.

## Tier by payer source of the stay

| Payer source of the stay on the date of service | Ancillary account tier |
|---|---|
| Part A episode | Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing |
| Medicaid eligible case | Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance |
| Hospice election | Ancillary Account, Hospice Election |
| Medicare Advantage stay | Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage |
| Private-pay or Medicaid-pending stay, resident has Part B | Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B |
| Private-pay or Medicaid-pending stay, resident does not have Part B | Ancillary Account, Private Pay |

Each tier's payer class is the payer named in that tier. When the stay's payer source changes, the account's tier changes with it, effective on the date the new payer source starts.

## Account states

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pending setup | The account is set up for the resident; ancillary billing has not started |
| Open | The resident's payer source is confirmed and ancillary billing has started |
| Closed | After discharge, the last ancillary charges are settled and the account is closed |

An account moves from pending setup to open when the resident's payer source is confirmed and ancillary billing starts, and from open to closed after discharge, once the last ancillary charges are settled.

## Closing condition

An account is closed only when its balance is zero. The balance considered is the account's balance in the company's records for that account. A hypothetical balance of USD 0.00 meets the condition; a balance of USD 4.17 does not.

## Points of judgement

- **A Medicaid-pending stay for a resident without Part B.** Ancillary Account, Private Pay.
- **A Medicaid-pending stay for a resident with Part B.** Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B.
